intervals.label: R&D, conceptual design and design stage (not yet funded for construction)
intervals.note: Start is fiscal year 2020 (the paper says the R&D 'began in FY20'). The 2022 plan to start construction in late 2024 was not met: the SNOLAB 2025 report says the design stage is finished, the experiment 'is technically ready to begin construction, but a clear funding path for the full-scale experiment has not yet been secured' (arXiv:2507.11368, Sec. 4.5). No source read gives an approval or a construction start.
intervals.quote: The R&D effort, which began in FY20, is currently entering the design phase with the goal of being ready to start construction in late 2024.

placements.note: Planned at SNOLAB, site record 'snolab-underground-lab'; the paper gives no specific lab area.
placements.quote: Oscura is planning to operate at SNOLAB with 2070 m overburden

depth.quote: Oscura is planning to operate at SNOLAB with 2070 m overburden

exposure.quote: with a total exposure of 30 kg-yr

summary.plain: A planned array of silicon CCD sensors that can count single electrons, kept cold in liquid nitrogen inside heavy shielding.
summary.technical: About 28 gigapixels of skipper-CCDs (15 um pixels) in 1500 multi-chip modules arranged in 100 supermodules of 16, read out by cold electronics, in a liquid-nitrogen pressure vessel inside a lead and polyethylene shield.

technology.quote: Oscura is a proposed multi-kg skipper-CCD experiment designed for a dark matter (DM) direct detection search
technology.value: Skipper-CCD silicon array with sub-electron readout noise
